scenes.analysis: The rejected clip had two defects: the face was not the reference woman, and the lips did not follow the song. Both were measured and fixed separately. (1) FACE. ArcFace similarity to the reference photo (scripts/face_ref_similarity.py): the ref2va render scored 0.030 - not a drifting face but a DIFFERENT WOMAN. The fl2va render scores 0.944, and after lip-sync 0.932 (min 0.897), so the lip-sync does not damage the identity. (2) LIPS. LatentSync 1.6 (local, open weights) drives the mouth from the actual track. The pipeline has a constant ~625 ms lead between the mouth and the audio features, so the driver track is given 625 ms earlier (track 37.375-44.675) while the delivered audio stays at 38.0-45.3. The correlation between the audio envelope and mouth openness goes from -0.030 (inverted, lips moving against the music) to +0.227, and the mouth amplitude grows fourfold. Vision on six frames: the mouth is clearly open in three frames and closed in three, identity 8/10, continuity 8.5/10, overall 7/10. What is still weak: the skin is airbrushed and poreless (5.5/10) and the mouth articulation is mostly binary open/closed rather than varied vowel shapes. Both are H3-generation limits, not the two defects this clip was rejected for.

pipeline.step_1_render: scripts/h3_i2v_run.py --image boho_src.jpg --guide-image boho_guide.jpg --guide-frame 87 --tst-tau 0.2 --sampler res_multistep --scheduler beta --seed 424245 --steps 20 (fl2va: face locked, mouth closed)
pipeline.step_2_lipsync: scripts/lipsync_clip.py --video BOHO_INSTR2.mp4 --audio ace_driver_early.wav (track 37.375-44.675, i.e. 625 ms earlier than the delivered window) --fps 25 --out-fps 24 --steps 20 --lips-expression 1.5
pipeline.step_3_mux: resample the 25 fps lipsync result to 24 fps / 175 frames, then mux track 38.0-45.3 as the audio
pipeline.why_this_order: fl2va keeps the reference face (0.944) but cannot take an external track; LatentSync adds the singing on top and leaves the identity intact (0.933).
pipeline.comfyui_patch: scripts/apply_latentsync_patches.py - the wrapper lives outside the repo and needs three fixes: torchvision.io.read_video/write_video are gone, and the per-chunk tensors must be freed or a 175-frame clip OOMs around chunk 10-12.
pipeline.latency_note: LatentSync leads the audio by ~625 ms (measured: the mouth at frame j matches the audio at j+15). Feed it the track 625 ms earlier than the window you deliver.
